turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi Mr Tan, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Okay lah, a bit sore but manageable. No major pain one.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: What would you say your pain level is on a scale of 1 to 10?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe 3 or 4? The incision area got some throbbing, but the paracetamol seems to help.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any nausea or vomiting? We gave you ondansetron to prevent that.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, thank God. Stomach is fine, no dizziness or anything.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Breathing comfortable? No shortness of breath or airway issues?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Breathing is okay. Spinal anesthesia made me a bit worried, but I can breathe freely now.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Did you experience any awareness or discomfort during the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I was out cold. Woke up only when they moved me to recovery.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Your blood pressure and sugar levels are stable. Any knee pain affecting your mobility?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Knees are stiff as usual, but not worse than before. Can bend them slowly.
